text:
deploy-bot: rollout started: svc-inference-eu v3 -> 20% traffic at 2026-03-17T10:45Z. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/rollouts/1788 - spike in 5xxs reported

maya: seeing crashloopbackoffs on svc-inference-eu-v3 pods. readiness probe path returns 404. logs show app trying /health/v2 but manifest expects /healthz

jon: confirmed — new manifest changed probe path and also accidentally set HPA minReplicas: 0 in kustomize overlay. this explains scale-to-zero blips under load.

sam: customers hitting 503 from /v1/generate in eu region. error-rate ~11% avg across the last 6m on the SLO dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/slo/inference-eu (alerting: PD page).

pagerduty: trigger: P1 - inference-eu 5xx spike -> paging oncall-sre

oncall-sre: I'm on it. taking lead, will coordinate rollback + ff kill-switch. @maya can you confirm whether flip of flag is possible immediately? :eyes:

maya: yes, we have a feature flag controlling v3 cutover: ff/inference-eu-v3. can toggle via internal flags-api.

maya: recommending kill-switch first to stop new traffic to v3 while we patch. command: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/ff/inference-eu-v3 -d '{"enabled": false}'
```

jon: also preparing an emergency k8s patch for HPA minReplicas and probe. will apply both if kill-switch not enough.

maya: applied kill-switch -> response 200 OK. dashboard shows immediate drop in v3 traffic to 0%.

deploy-bot: traffic routing update succeeded. v3 instances no longer in traffic pool.

sam: error-rate dropping but still seeing unhealthy pods causing resource churn on nodes (OOMs and preemption). need HPA minReplicas fix to keep steady capacity.

jon: running quick patch: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch hpa svc-inference --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
kubectl -n prod set probe deploy/svc-inference --readiness --get-url=https://:8080/healthz
```

maya: patch applied, readiness probe restored to /healthz on v3, but we'll keep v3 out of rotation until smoke tests pass.

incident-bot: rollback attempt advised. oncall-sre requested: rollout undo to stable replicaset for svc-inference-eu.

oncall-sre: executing rollback now -> `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy svc-inference --to-revision=2`

deploy-bot: rollback triggered, watching rollout status...

deploy-bot: rollout complete. stable replicaset (rev 2) at desired state.

sam: SLOs back to green in eu region, 5xxs down to baseline. customer impact window ~09:45-09:54 UTC (~9m). estimated affected requests ~18k (11% error rate of EU traffic). no customer data exposure.

oncall-sre: incident status -> mitigated. will keep thread open for postmortem items. action items: 
- CI manifest lint: fail on HPA minReplicas < 1 and probe path mismatches.
- Flagging UX: make default flag state in release pipeline explicit (don't assume true).
- Run a canary smoke check step that validates readiness path and HPA before routing traffic.

maya: filed INC-2026-1788 with timeline and logs. attaching pod logs + HPA yaml.

incident-bot: PD runbook step complete. notify customer success to prepare outreach: impact ~11% 503s EU, duration 9m.

oncall-sre: closing paging loop. great job team. :thumbsup:

sam: follow-up tomorrow: small release to test CI lint, and add an automated smoke test that hits /healthz on new revisions.

maya: ack. I'll own the smoke test PR.

jon: will open a change to the kustomize overlays to prevent accidental minReplicas=0.

incident-bot: thread locked for summary drafting.
